title: Advanced Whack-a-Mole 3D
prompt:
Create a complete single-file HTML page implementing an advanced 3D Whack-a-Mole game using Three.js and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 8, 10) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Create a ground plane (20x20, green color #2d5a1e) with receiveShadow.
- Create a 3x3 grid of 'mole holes' on the ground, each represented by a dark brown cylinder (radius 0.6, height 0.1) centered at positions: (-3,0,-3), (0,0,-3), (3,0,-3), (-3,0,0), (0,0,0), (3,0,0), (-3,0,3), (0,0,3), (3,0,3). Index them 0-8 left-to-right, back-to-front.

## Mole Model
- Load the 3D model 'facecap.glb' using GLTFLoader. Clone it 9 times, one per hole. Scale each clone to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Position each mole below its hole (y = -1.5) when hidden. When a mole pops up, animate it to y = 0.8 over 300ms using a smooth ease-out.

## Game Mechanics
- The game has three phases: 'idle' (before start), 'playing', and 'ended'.
- Add a DOM 'Start Game' button (id='startBtn') centered at top. Clicking it starts the game with a 60-second countdown.
- During 'playing', randomly select 1-3 moles to pop up every 1.5 seconds. Each mole stays up for 1.2 seconds before retreating (animate y back to -1.5 over 200ms). A mole that is already up should not be selected again.
- The player clicks on moles using raycasting. A successful hit on a visible (up) mole: (a) increments score by 10, (b) plays a 'bonk' effect by briefly scaling the mole to (0.7, 0.3, 0.7) then back, (c) immediately starts the mole retreating, (d) increments hitCount.
- If the player clicks and misses all moles (clicks ground or empty space), increment missCount.
- Track a combo system: consecutive hits without a miss increase combo by 1. Combo resets to 0 on a miss. If combo >= 3, each hit awards 10 + (combo * 5) bonus points instead of flat 10.
- After 60 seconds, set phase to 'ended', stop spawning moles, and display a 'Game Over' overlay (id='gameOverOverlay') showing final score.

## HUD / UI
- Score display (id='scoreDisplay') top-left showing 'Score: X'.
- Timer display (id='timerDisplay') top-right showing 'Time: Xs'.
- Combo display (id='comboDisplay') below score showing 'Combo: Xn' (where n is combo count).
- Hit/Miss ratio display (id='ratioDisplay') showing 'Hits: X | Misses: Y'.
- All HUD elements use white text, 24px font, with dark semi-transparent background.

## Difficulty Scaling
- From 0-20s: spawn 1 mole at a time, mole stay duration 1.2s.
- From 20-40s: spawn 1-2 moles, mole stay duration 1.0s.
- From 40-60s: spawn 1-3 moles, mole stay duration 0.8s.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- phase: 'idle' | 'playing' | 'ended'
- score: number (current score)
- timeRemaining: number (seconds left, integer)
- combo: number (current combo streak)
- hitCount: number (total successful hits)
- missCount: number (total misses)
- molesUp: number (count of moles currently in the up/visible position, y > 0)
- totalMolesSpawned: number (total moles that have popped up during the game)
- difficultyTier: 1 | 2 | 3 (current difficulty level based on time)
- moleStates: array of 9 booleans (true if mole is up/visible)
- lastHitIndex: number (-1 if no hit yet, otherwise index 0-8 of last hit mole)
- gameOverShown: boolean (true if game over overlay is visible)

## Additional Requirements
- Use OrbitControls but limit: no panning, polar angle 0.3 to 1.2, zoom between 5 and 20.
- Add particle effect on hit: spawn 8 small yellow spheres that fly outward and fade.
- Render shadows properly. Use a renderer with antialias and set pixelRatio to devicePixelRatio.
- The game must be fully playable and all state transitions must be deterministic given user input.
physics_constraints: Moles must animate vertically between y=-1.5 (hidden) and y=0.8 (visible) with smooth easing. Score must never decrease. Combo resets to 0 on miss. Timer counts down from 60 to 0 and never goes negative. Difficulty tier transitions at exactly 40s remaining and 20s remaining.
